results.name: blank vs empty text follows Microsoft's definitions (27 cases): ISBLANK only for empty cells, COUNTA counts "", ISTEXT/ISNONTEXT/TYPE of an empty cell, through OFFSET/INDEX/whole columns/array constants

*IF / *IFS criteria (30 cases): an error cell never fails the function and matches its own error literal; "=" = empty cells only, "" = empty + empty text, "<>" = non-empty; wildcards see text only, ~ escapes; size mismatch → #VALUE!
error literals are error CONSTANTS (ECMA-376 ST_CellError), case-insensitive; '#N/A stays text; #bogus / #SPILL! typed stay text; textInput quotes an error-looking text so it round-trips as text
reader: every constant empty-text cell of the 8 corpus workbooks that have them is kept as non-blank empty text — the SAME cells lxml finds (6 190 cells); TT67 dropped them all

hostile / edge cell shapes (18): which XML is empty text, which is no value — sst "" / rich-empty / spaced index → empty text; empty, negative, fractional or out-of-range index, inlineStr without <is>, str without <v> → no value; lxml agrees on every empty-text verdict; text "#N/A" stays text
writer: a constant empty-text cell is saved (shared string ""), a blank is not; openpyxl sees '' vs no cell; re-read keeps ISBLANK FALSE / COUNTA 1; styled blank stays blank

lossless save: untouched empty-text cells keep their original <c> byte-for-byte; a cell edited to empty text is written as an empty inline string; openpyxl opens it and lxml lists exactly the original empty-text cells plus the new one
